clues.title: Plate: Lebanon
text: Standard Lebanese licence plates are either long with a blue strip on the left, similar to most licence plates in Europe, or short with a similar blue strip on the left or above, which makes it unique. Licence plates on taxis are notably deep red. You may also find licence plates with other colours.
